appDescription: An app that records the places of a car trip and recommends travel roadmaps shared by other drivers.

function.name: SHOW_TRAVEL_INFO
function.description: Tells the user today's Travel Crumbs trip records or recommended travel roadmaps for a region.

infoType.description: Which Travel Crumbs information to tell the user.

region.description: Korean city, county, district or province name the user asked about for recommended roadmaps; omit when the user did not name a place.
